title: The list's Display menu closes after a layout is chosen and on Escape
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, `/crm_opportunity`: open Display, choose Layout › Kanban. The board renders behind the menu and the menu stays open over the first column; Escape does not close it; it closes on the next click elsewhere (the New button in the walk, which then also opened the form).

## Target

1. Choosing a layout closes the menu (the choice is complete); toggles inside the menu (row numbers, inline edit, density) keep it open.
2. Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the Display button.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (or the Display popover component the list toolbar mounts), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: selecting Kanban closes the popover; Escape closes it and focuses the trigger.
2. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `b72c97985`, never merged): [hotcrm-opportunity-kanban-first-25.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-opportunity-kanban-first-25.jpg?raw=true) · [hotcrm-display-menu.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-display-menu.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
